qualification_policy.owner_route_meaning: Maintainer or publishing repository routing; not assignment to a named person.
qualification_policy.build_equivalence: Use the cluster build context, Dockerfile, build arguments and linux/amd64 target. Qualify both builder and runtime stages.
promotion_requires: All 12 disclosed chains rejected through applicable effective clients
Sample build and functional checks passed
Source revision, base/output digests, platform, tested clients and unresolved gaps recorded

gaps.grpc_live_negative: All twelve live gRPC negative checks are currently inconclusive because the endpoints close HTTP/2 before exposing certificate-verification evidence; offline rejection and live positive checks alone provide partial coverage.
gaps.local_validation: Fresh linux/amd64 build, selected trust checks, and sample functionality checks must be recorded against source and image digests before rollout.
gaps.native_clients: OS PEM verification does not qualify the application binary, native SDKs, plugins, gRPC, libcurl, database clients, or custom TLS contexts unless that client is exercised.
gaps.custom_trust: Explicit application CA files, mounted secrets, user overrides, and dependencies installed after qualification can select different trust.
gaps.managed_publishers: Managed catalog entries have no Dockerfile here; remediation and image rollout belong to their publishing repositories.
gaps.prebuilt_publishers: Wrapper fixes cannot retrospectively qualify the publisher build environment or every embedded client; publisher rebuild and provenance remain a separate workstream.
gaps.mathworks_runtime: The bundled Oracle Java 8u202 trust store is rebuilt from corrected OS anchors and requires native JVM validation. Broader obsolete-runtime risks, MathWorks native HTTP clients, and compiled-wheel provenance remain separate assessment items.
gaps.influxdb3_runtime: InfluxDB3 remains unmodified: current registry metadata lookup timed out, and Rust/webpki plus Python plugin trust require assessment.
gaps.dynamic_connectors: Kafka Connect downloads user-selected connectors; each plugin and its independent trust bundles require qualification.
gaps.external_templates: project-templates.json points to ten separate repositories on main. Changing this release/v5 branch does not change those sources.
gaps.published_artifacts: Published Instant Deploy images and existing copied/deployed samples are unchanged until separately rebuilt and rolled out.
